<!-- en -->
v0.1.1 is the second stable release of token-usage. It consolidates every change shipped across v0.1.1-rc.1, v0.1.1-rc.2, and the five commits after rc.2; the two prereleases are retired after this release, so this page is the authoritative record for v0.1.1. RC users can update in place with `token-usage update` (no `--version` needed).

### Highlights
- Fully bilingual user-facing output: `English / 中文` for every console message, error, query table, flag description, and the entire config TUI; log messages are now English-only
- Windows console: Chinese output renders correctly in cmd and PowerShell 5.1 — the console code page is switched to UTF-8 for the command's duration and restored afterwards
- `start` fails fast with guidance instead of a confusing 5-second timeout when no client is enabled (nothing to monitor)
- Collection reliability: Codex subagent sessions, OpenCode `models.json` registry schema, ZCode provider-map version 2 schema, and Claude JSONL lines whose `message.content` is a plain string are all handled correctly
- Logging governance: heartbeat logs are demoted to debug, expected-path chatter is removed or aggregated into one summary per scan, and watchers no longer re-register on session-file removals — at the default `info` level a full day of daemon activity fits within a handful of lifecycle lines
- Query tables are redrawn as box-drawing tables with display-width alignment, two-line `English`/`中文` headers, a unified trailing column set, and a new cache-hit-rate column

### Fixed
- Codex: collection no longer fails on subagent sessions whose `session_meta.payload.source` is an object (e.g. `{"subagent":{...}}`) — both string and object shapes are accepted, and a session-meta payload with unexpected field types degrades to ID-only extraction instead of dropping the whole session. Sessions previously recorded as "missing session ID" errors are collected after retrying
- ZCode: provider display names are restored when `bots-model-cache.v2.json` uses the version 2 schema (provider names moved from the top-level `providers` array into `workspaceConfigOptions`); both schemas are parsed and an unparsable file still degrades to raw provider IDs
- OpenCode: collection no longer fails when `models.json` uses the registry-shaped provider schema (upstream changed flat `provider → display-name` strings into provider objects); both schemas are parsed, and an unparsable file degrades to an empty mapping with a warning instead of blocking collection
- Claude: JSONL lines whose `message.content` is a plain string (a legal upstream shape for user messages) are accepted without per-file parse-summary noise; existing stored data is unaffected
- Watcher: removing a session file no longer triggers a full directory-watch re-registration, eliminating debug-log spam during session-file rotation

### Changed
- New configurations start with every client disabled (`enabled = false`) and no default router or provider alias — enable the clients you use, then collect. Existing configuration files are not rewritten and are unaffected
- Setting a non-empty `router` on a client outside the Claude family is rejected at the configuration entry points (`config set` fails up front, including quoted dotted-key forms; the config TUI shows no router field for such clients and save validation rejects one). Clearing with an empty value is always allowed, and existing configurations that already contain such a value are still read without errors
- All console output, errors, table labels, flag descriptions, and the entire config TUI are bilingual (`English / 中文`); log messages are English-only, with the error field keeping the bilingual error text
- Daemon heartbeat logs (`collection started`, `collection completed`, database-change triggers, debounce triggers, router rounds) are demoted to debug
- Expected-path debug logs are no longer printed per row — CC Switch raw logs that cannot be associated with a message no longer log at all, ZCode provider-mapping fallbacks and Claude JSONL parse skips are aggregated into one summary per collection (with a count), and directory-watch registration prints one summary per watcher
- Daemon fallback output (pre-startup output, and stdout/stderr on Windows) is redirected to `logs/daemon-fallback.log` instead of `daemon.out.log` / `daemon.err.log` in the data directory; on macOS, panics after logger startup are merged into the daily rotating log file. Stale legacy fallback files are cleaned up on daemon start, and the fallback file is pruned by age and rotated by size
- Custom `log.dir` values that point to a not-yet-existing directory are created before the daemon spawns, so `start` no longer fails in that case; the read-only `status` command never creates directories
- The config TUI status message after a successful save tells you that you can press q to quit or keep editing; contributor docs now say commit messages are in English
- Query tables use box-drawing borders with display-width alignment (CJK counted as two columns), two-line English/Chinese headers, and a unified trailing column set: Requests / Input / Output / Cache Read / Reasoning / Total / Cache Hit. The `query sessions` subcommand is renamed to `query session`; the views no longer show Cache Create (always zero for the common clients — the value still feeds the cache-hit denominator and remains visible in `query summary`); Reasoning stays a separate column (included in Total; about 0.08% of the local token volume)

### Installation
See the [README Quick Start](https://github.com/YuLaiZ/token-usage#quick-start). Existing users update in place with `token-usage update`; users on v0.1.1-rc.1/rc.2 are upgraded to v0.1.1 by the same command.

<!-- zh -->
v0.1.1 是 token-usage 的第二个稳定版，完整汇总 v0.1.1-rc.1、v0.1.1-rc.2 以及 rc.2 之后 5 笔提交交付的全部变更；本稳定版发布后两个预发布版即退役，本页为 v0.1.1 的权威记录。rc 用户可用 `token-usage update`（无需 `--version`）原地升级。

### 亮点
- 用户可见输出全面双语：所有控制台消息、错误、查询表格、flag 描述与整个 config TUI 均为 `English / 中文`；日志消息仅英文
- Windows 控制台：中文输出在 cmd 与 PowerShell 5.1 下正常显示——命令运行期间控制台代码页切换为 UTF-8，退出后自动恢复
- 无任何启用客户端时 `start` 立即给出引导并退出，不再等待误导性的 5 秒超时
- 采集可靠性：Codex 子代理会话、OpenCode `models.json` 注册表 schema、ZCode provider 映射 v2 schema、Claude `message.content` 为纯字符串的行全部正确处理
- 日志治理：心跳日志降为 debug、预期路径噪音移除或聚合为每轮一条汇总、会话文件删除不再触发 watcher 重注册——默认 `info` 级别下守护进程一整天的活跃输出收敛到几条生命周期日志
- query 表格重构为框线表格：显示宽度对齐、两行英文/中文表头、统一尾部列与新增缓存命中率列

### 修复
- Codex：子代理会话的 `session_meta.payload.source` 为对象（如 `{"subagent":{...}}`）时采集不再失败——字符串与对象两种形态均兼容；session_meta 出现未知字段类型时降级为仅提取 ID，不再整条丢弃。此前被记为「缺少 session ID」错误的会话，重试后即可正常采集
- ZCode：`bots-model-cache.v2.json` 升级 version 2 schema（provider 显示名从顶层 `providers` 数组挪入 `workspaceConfigOptions`）后显示名恢复；两种 schema 均解析，文件无法解析时仍回退 provider 原值
- OpenCode：上游把 `models.json` 的扁平 provider→显示名映射改为注册表对象结构后，采集不再失败——两种 schema 均可解析；文件无法解析时降级为空映射并记 WARN 日志，不阻断采集
- Claude：`message.content` 为纯字符串的行（user 消息的合法上游形态）不再触发按文件汇总的解析噪音；既有存量数据不受影响
- watcher：删除会话文件不再触发目录监听全量重注册，消除会话文件轮转时的 debug 日志刷屏

### 变更
- 新初始化的配置所有客户端默认关闭（`enabled = false`），且不带默认 router 与 provider 别名——按需开启客户端后再采集。已有配置文件不会被重写，不受影响
- 非 Claude 家族客户端设置非空 `router` 会在配置入口被拒绝（`config set` 直接报错，含引号 dotted-key 写法；config TUI 对此类客户端不展示 router 字段，保存校验拒绝非空值）。设为空值清除始终放行；存量配置中已存在的该类值读取不受影响
- 全部控制台输出、错误、表格标签、flag 描述与整个 config TUI 双语化（`English / 中文`）；日志消息仅英文，error 字段保留双语错误文本
- daemon 心跳日志（开始采集、采集完成、数据库变化触发、防抖触发、router 轮）降为 debug
- 预期路径的 debug 日志不再逐条打印——CC Switch 无法关联消息的 raw 记录完全不打日志，ZCode provider 映射回退与 Claude JSONL 行解析跳过聚合为每次采集一条汇总（带计数），目录监听注册改为每个 watcher 一条汇总
- daemon 兜底输出（日志初始化前的极早期输出，以及 Windows 上的全周期 stdout/stderr）重定向到 `logs/daemon-fallback.log`，不再在数据目录产生 `daemon.out.log` / `daemon.err.log`；macOS 上日志初始化完成后的 panic 输出并入按日轮转的日志文件。启动时清理旧版遗留的兜底文件，fallback 文件按闲置时间清理、按大小轮转
- 自定义 `log.dir` 指向尚不存在的目录时会在 daemon 拉起前创建，`start` 不再因此失败；只读的 `status` 命令不创建任何目录
- config TUI 保存成功后的状态信息提示可按 q 退出或继续编辑；贡献指南的提交信息语言表述改为英文
- query 表格采用框线边框与显示宽度对齐（中文按 2 列计）、两行英文/中文表头，尾部列统一为：请求数 / 输入 / 输出 / 缓存读取 / 推理 / 总计 / 缓存命中。`query sessions` 子命令更名为 `query session`；各视图不再展示缓存创建列（常用客户端恒为 0——其数值仍计入缓存命中率分母，`query summary` 中可见）；推理保持独立列（已计入总计；本机约占 token 总量 0.08%）

### 安装
见 [README 快速开始](https://github.com/YuLaiZ/token-usage/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md#快速开始)。已有用户用 `token-usage update` 原地升级；处于 v0.1.1-rc.1/rc.2 的用户执行同一命令即可升到 v0.1.1。
